As a Merchandising Specialist, you will: Serve as Senior Inventory Management Specialist responsible for reviewing the system content to evaluate the quality and accuracy of data concerning advertising, direct mail marketing, broadcast ads, customer internet purchasing, product maintenance, and product discontinuance information and for preparing reports related to Sales and Marketing.

Participate in the development of priorities and develops strategies to analyze, forecast, and actual sales and inventory requirements.

Monitor inventory availability of numismatic products across all logical warehouse locations; identify re-order points along with entering, monitoring, and changing purchase orders to accurately communicate inventory availability to call center and website; process purchase orders requests for United States Mint sales locations; identify and correct all system transaction errors, which include, invoice errors, pick ticket voids, and inventory transaction errors; direct the fulfillment center to perform all inventory moves; review and approve all inventory adjustment requests; support audits.

Manage inventory physicals, de-trashing projects, and `end of year' efforts, and other projects. Create and analyze a variety of reports in The Order Management System, these include, advertising, purchasing, in transit, backorder, sales, low inventory, UPC codes, set up, and physical inventory reports.

Establish merchandise inventory project requirements and priorities and develop strategies, including coordinating work requirements and project resources, to achieve short or long-term goals.
You must meet the following requirements within 14 days of the closing date of this announcement. The experience may have been gained in either the public, private sector or volunteer service. One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-time work is considered on a prorated basis.

Be sure all experience is documented in your resume by indicating place of employment, job title, length of time performing the duties, and the name and contact information for the supervisor. We must be able to verify this experience in your resume in order for you to receive credit.

Specialized Experience: For the GS-13, you must have one year of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position includes: - Managing inventory control, inventory accountability, and order fulfillment operations; AND - Analyzing sales, inventory, purchasing, shipping, or merchandising data to support operational decisions; AND - Coordinating warehouse, shipping, inventory, or fulfillment activities; AND - Developing reports, procedures, or recommendations to improve inventory management and operational effectiveness.

In addition to the above requirements, you must meet the following time-in-grade requirement, if applicable: For the GS-13 you must have been at the GS-12 level for 52 weeks.

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need.

Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come. The Role We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Director of Finance, Merchandising to own and help drive top-line and margin growth.

As the owner of all aspects of Product Revenue, our largest revenue stream, and product gross margin, you will lead budgeting, forecasting/pacing, and the monthly close, and drive the analysis of strategic projects that grow product revenue and gross margin.

You will become a catalog and brand expert and the go-to resource for understanding product discovery, pricing, basket composition, and the margin dynamics that inform and guide our merchandising strategy.

You will serve as the primary finance business partner to the Merchandising team, working closely and cross-functionally with Data, Product, Marketing, and Operations, to build the financial models and analyses that help your partners make the best strategic decisions to drive revenue growth and margin expansion.You will also own the financial partnership on new initiative launches end to end, working alongside business leadership from opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analyses, go-to-market strategy and the definition and tracking of success criteria.

Strong data fluency is an important component of the role.

You will partner closely with our Data Analytics team, self-serving in the data warehouse where needed, designing reporting outputs that generate insights, and advising on metric definitions and UAT, acting as the intermediary who brings business context to the data partners and data context to the business partners.

Ultimately, you will construct the data-driven narrative around how Merchandising drives top-line growth and profitability for Board and Executive audiences.

Our ideal candidate is extremely analytical and solution-oriented, enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong business partnerships, and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Responsibilities
Lead all aspects of the bottoms-up modeling and forecasting of Product Revenue and Margin for the annual budget, re-forecasts, rolling projections, and ad-hoc strategic initiatives.
Partner with business leadership to own financials of new initiative launches, from opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and strategic review through go-to-market strategy and the definition and tracking of success criteria.
Provide detailed, insightful monthly financial reporting and variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast) with commentary on key drivers for the Board, Executives, and business partners.
Own and monitor the relevant customer and merchandising KPIs, including order frequency, AOV, basket composition, pricing competitiveness and inflation, product gross margin, and product contribution margin.
Lead promotional analysis, evaluating the effectiveness and margin impact of promotions and shaping future promotional strategy and spend.
Directly impact revenue and margin by identifying opportunities and making strategic recommendations on pricing (including regional and key-value-item strategy), catalog mix and expansion, partnerships, and member shopping experience.
Analyze new product-launch proposals and catalog expansion to ensure the business case and financial impact align with category, portfolio, and company targets, measuring the true incremental impact net of cannibalization.
Own Product Contribution Margin at the portfolio level and continue to develop methodology for estimating SKU and order-level contribution margin.
Partner closely with the Data Analytics team, self-serving where needed, designing reporting and dashboard outputs, and advising on metric definitions, UAT, and data quality so that reporting drives sound decisions.
Continuously review existing reporting and forecasting processes, identifying opportunities to streamline, standardize, and automate wherever possible to improve accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
Build and mentor a team that is respected and viewed as thought partners by all levels across the company.

9+ years of progressive financial analysis experience in high-growth environments, ideally with direct experience in FP&A and/or revenue forecasting.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a relevant field; MBA is a plus.
Background in FP&A, strategic finance, investment banking, management consulting, or similar strongly preferred.

Advanced proficiency with Excel; expert at creating efficient, clean, complex, and dynamic financial models.

CALIDA, en tant que l'une des marques de lingerie leaders en Europe, mise sur la durabilité depuis sa création en 1941 - bien avant que cela ne devienne tendance. Car la durabilité ne devrait pas être une mode, mais une promesse. C'est pourquoi nous poursuivons encore aujourd'hui l'objectif de produire la meilleure qualité.

Dans chaque pièce, pour chaque jour, pour chaque nuit, pour les grands et les petits. Produire la meilleure lingerie signifie aussi pour nous ne pas la fabriquer au détriment des générations futures. Pour atteindre cet objectif tourné vers l'avenir, il faut toi, nous, toutes les personnes dans le monde qui veulent agir ensemble.
# Merchandiser/Allocateure Retail (h/f/d) #
## Temps de travail : 40 % / Lieu de travail : Sursee ##
La qualité à chaque instant commence avec TOI - en tant qu'acteur international de la mode, nous évoluons dans un environnement de travail très dynamique. La perfection, l'air du temps, l'innovation et la durabilité sont nos moteurs centraux.

Dans le rôle de Merchandiser Retail, tu mets en œuvre de manière dynamique les thèmes liés aux marchandises issus des plans d'affaires jusqu'au point de vente et assures, par des mesures ciblées en cours de saison, des surfaces productives.

Tu garantis un flux fluide de marchandises et de données en utilisant les systèmes et en exécutant des processus spécifiques aux clients. Deviens membre de la famille CALIDA et façonne avec nous l'avenir textile de demain.
Ton domaine d'action
* Coordination d'équipe : Tu assures la planification structurée de toutes les tâches prioritaires au sein de l'équipe et garantis leur mise en œuvre dans les délais.
* Analyse de performance : Tu observes et évalues continuellement la performance des surfaces et des assortiments par le biais de rapports, de monitoring et de benchmarking.
* Gestion des assortiments : Tu réalises des analyses Renner/Penner, identifies les enseignements et déduis des mesures d'optimisation ciblées.
* Gestion du flux de marchandises : Tu contrôles et optimises le flux de marchandises NOS, établis des prévisions de besoins et surveilles la livraison pendant la saison.
* Traitement des processus : Tu t'occupes du traitement des arriérés et des stocks cibles, des retours, des factures et des inventaires.
Ce qui est important pour nous
* Tu es un véritable joueur d'équipe et sais établir et entretenir de solides relations de travail avec différents départements.
* Avec ta compréhension des évolutions saisonnières des ventes, des besoins des clients et de la planification marketing, tu agis toujours de manière orientée marché et cible.
* Tu possèdes d'excellentes compétences informatiques (Excel, PowerPoint, outils de gestion des marchandises et de reporting) et apprends rapidement de nouveaux systèmes.
* Tu convaincs par d'excellentes connaissances en allemand ; la maîtrise du français est un atout supplémentaire.
* Tu travailles probablement les lundis et mercredis.
Tu cherches plus qu'un simple emploi ? Chez CALIDA, nous ne créons pas des postes, nous façonnons des carrières. Tes compétences et tes passions sont ici demandées. Écrivons ensemble la prochaine success story et postule dès maintenant en ligne.
Un processus de recrutement transparent et personnel t'attend chez nous, mettant tes compétences et ta personnalité au centre.
**1. Check-in digital (30 minutes) :**
Commence ton parcours par un entretien digital via Teams. Tu peux ainsi nous découvrir et en apprendre plus sur ton rôle potentiel chez nous, confortablement depuis chez toi.
**2. Rencontre en personne au siège à Sursee (2-3 heures) :**
Après un premier entretien réussi, nous t'invitons à une rencontre en personne à notre siège. Plonge plus profondément dans le poste, rencontre l'équipe en personne et découvre notre environnement de travail inspirant lors d'une visite des bureaux.
